lags). |\n| `--all-targets` | No | Run **every** attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one **paid run per targ
et** |\n| `--iterations <n>` | No | Run each case this many times (1-10), for this run only |\n| `--repetitions <n>` | No | **Lega
cy** spelling of `--iterations`. Passing both is an error. |\n| `--case <id-or-title...>` | No | Run only these cases instead of t
he whole suite |\n| `--exclude-skills` | No | Run the \"without skills\" A/B arm: nothing is pinned, and the run is labelled as ex
cluded |\n| `--refresh-snapshot` | No | **Persists a new host-config snapshot on the suite** (see below). Single-target runs only.
|\n| `--notes <text>` | No | Free-text note stored on the run |\n| `--min-pass-rate <n>` | No | Pass threshold for this run (0-10
0), overriding the suite's own |\n| `--match-options <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. `'{\"toolCallOrder\
":\"exact\"}'` |\n| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file`, a fresh key is minted and
printed on every invocation when this flag is omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run instead of starting a new on
e |\n| `--wait` | No | Wait for every launched run to reach a terminal status |\n| `--wait-timeout <ms>` | No | Maximum wait time
(default 2100000); requires `--wait` |\n| `--reporter <json-summary\\|junit-xml\\|html>` | No | Write the completed structured rep
ort to stdout; requires `--wait`. `html` is a self-contained decision summary + failures page — traces/parity/history are not incl
uded. |\n| `--out <path>` | No | Atomically write the completed report to a file; defaults to `json-summary`, or uses `--reporter`
when present; requires `--wait` |\n| `--compose-client <id-or-name>` | No | Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved envi
ronment (see below). **Ephemeral by default** — pass `--save-targets` to attach it to the suite. |\n| `--compose-host <id-or-name>
` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--compose-client` |\n| `--compose-computer <id-or-name>` | No | Sandbox image to pin on the com
posed stack |\n| `--compose-model <id...>` | No | Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the client's pinned model unless
`--with-client-default` is set |\n| `--compose-model-selection <json...>` | No | Whole saved model selection(s) — source, connect
ion, `settings.reasoningEffort` — as JSON: one cell per selection, for its model, at its effort. Repeat to add several selections
for one model (e.g. a\n| `--with-client-default` | No | Also launch an inherit cell using each client's pinned model, alongside `-
-compose-model` |\n| `--compose-server <id-or-name...>` | No | Server(s) to pin on the composed stack, snapshotted into a server g
